title: Colour block grid clears to footage headline
summary: A flat brand-colour field breaks into large square blocks that vanish in steps, uncovering street footage; a three-line caps headline stacks in bottom-left in the accent colour, settles to white and rides over a hard cut to a second clip.
use_when: Opening a news, editorial or social clip with a branded wipe into footage
Revealing a product shot or hero image from a solid brand colour
Short vertical or 4:5 feed posts that need a recognisable branded transition
Any two-clip sequence where one headline stays on top across the cut

look.type_style: heavy grotesk, all caps, tight leading (~0.9), left-aligned bottom-left, cap height ~5 % H, 3 lines; lines enter in a pale yellow accent and settle to white

sfx.event: each step of blocks clearing from the colour field
hard cut to the second clip

structure.shot: full-frame flat cyan field, square white logo tile top-right; from ~0.25 s square blocks start vanishing to show footage
structure.camera: static on the colour field; footage behind drifts with handheld motion (~1 px/s @1920)
structure.motion: blocks ~22 % W square on a fixed grid, cleared in random order with easings.stepped (whole blocks per step, no fade), first step f6-f8 (±0.25 s); logo tile static on top

structure.shot: street footage mostly revealed, last blocks left and right edges gone by 1.00 s; headline, 3 lines, 4 words, names the segment, stacks bottom-left
structure.motion: remaining blocks clear stepped until f30 (±0.25 s); headline lines appear whole one after another ~6 fr apart (±0.25 s): line 1 at f18, line 2 by f23, line 3 by f30; each enters accent yellow and fades to white over ~8-15 fr (easings.outQuint, ±0.25 s); all white by f38; hold

structure.shot: second street clip, same headline and logo tile held unchanged on top
structure.motion: no new motion; headline and logo tile hold in place across the cut

params.brand: brand.json: accent2/accent for the block field colour, a lighter accent for the entering headline lines, fg white, logo mark for the corner tile
params.content.clips: 2 footage clips (src + trim); clip 1 is revealed by the block grid, clip 2 enters on a hard cut
params.content.headline: 3 short caps lines, 1-2 words each, held over both clips
params.grid.cell: block size as a share of frame width (default 0.22)
params.grid.clearStart: frame the first blocks vanish (default 6 at 30 fps)
params.timing.cut: frame of the hard cut to clip 2 (default 92)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets, resolution 0.25 s. Blocks are square, ~249 px on a 1120 px frame (22 % W), aligned to a fixed grid; they vanish whole, no fade, in random order, f6-f30. Logo tile ~284 px (25 % W) top-right, sits above the grid. Headline lines appear whole (no visible entrance) in a pale yellow that settles to white. The headline is not re-animated on the hard cut at f92. Footage carries its own baked motion blur. Proposed term: block-dissolve (flat colour field cleared block by block to reveal the next shot); mapped to mask-wipe here. Proposed term: accent-settle (text enters in the accent colour, settles to the fg colour). sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Yellow accent (~#F2F06A) not in palettegen output; read by eye from cells 3-4.
